annotations.title: Build a quote in a chat

description: Builds a quote for one chat, named by conversation_id: lines from the number’s product list (priced by the list) and custom lines at a price you give, an optional discount, tax rate, deposit, the date it is valid until, and terms. The totals are worked out by Cosend. Nothing is sent to the customer: the quote stays a draft until it is sent. Returns the quote.

conversation_id.description: The chat the quote is for: its number and its customer.

deposit.description: Asked by payment link once the customer accepts: an amount, or a percentage of the total.

name.description: A custom line’s name. A product’s is the list’s.

product_id.description: A product of the chat’s number, priced by its list. Left out or null: a custom line.

unit_price.description: A custom line’s price, typed by the seller. A product is priced by the list.

tax_rate.description: A percentage of the subtotal after the discount, like "16".

valid_until.description: The last day the customer can accept it. Needed to send it.

name: create_quote
title: Build a quote in a chat
